groups.context: Follow the challenge to pirate leadership and the account of growing up with his father's crew.

records.Japanese:
くっ、また負けたか…
だが、今度こそ………はっ！
records.current_English:
Damn, I lost again...
 But next time... Huh?!

records.Japanese:
悪いが
あんたにゃ『今度』はねえんだ
records.current_English:
Sorry, but you ain't getting 
 a next time.

records.Japanese: くっくっくっ
records.current_English: Heh heh...

records.Japanese: なんだって！？　もう一度言ってみな！
records.current_English: What?! Say that again!

records.Japanese: ああ？　聞こえなかったか？
records.current_English: Huh? Didn't hear me?

records.Japanese:
あんたの言うことを聞くヤツなんざ
ここにゃ、誰もいねえってことよ！
records.current_English:
There's nobody left here who'll
 take orders from you!

records.Japanese:
…ちきしょう！
てめえら、裏切ったね！！
records.current_English: Damn you! You betrayed me!

records.Japanese: 向こうが騒がしいようだが…
records.current_English: There's a commotion over there...

records.Japanese:
くだんの女海賊を
配下が取り囲んでおるようですぞ
records.current_English:
That pirate's own men seem 
 to have surrounded her.

records.Japanese: …船を近づけろ
records.current_English: ...Bring us closer.

records.Japanese:
ここんとこ、負け続けでちっとも金が
増えやしねえ。あんたには、その責任を
とってもらわねえと
records.current_English:
We keep losing.
 Our pockets are empty. 
 You're gonna answer for it.

records.Japanese: 責任だと…
records.current_English: Answer?!

records.Japanese:
だいたい
なぜFOを
追いかけ回すんですかい？
records.current_English:
Why are we chasing 
 FO
 all over, anyway?

records.Japanese:
へっ、みんなに言えない
理由があるんだろ？！
records.current_English:
Heh. Got a reason you can't tell 
 the rest of us, huh?!

records.Japanese:
あんたの魂胆は
FOから
『血塗られたシャムシール』を
取り戻したいだけなんだ
親父の形見だもんな！
records.current_English:
You just want
 the Bloodstained Shamshir back 
 from FO.
 A keepsake from your old man!

records.Japanese: それは…そんなつもりじゃ…
records.current_English: That's... That wasn't what I...

records.Japanese:
最近のあんたは、なってなかったぜ
金も稼げねえ頭についていく物好きは
いねえよ。覚悟しな！
records.current_English:
You've been slipping. Who's
 gonna follow a captain who 
 can't make them any money? 
 You've got this coming!

records.Japanese:
提督！
このまま放っておけば
あの女、殺されますぞ！
records.current_English:
Admiral! If we do nothing, 
 they'll kill her!

records.Japanese: …見捨てるわけにもいくまい
records.current_English: We cannot abandon her.

records.Japanese: じゃ、行くぞ
records.current_English: Then I'm going in.

records.Japanese: お、おい、早まるでない！
records.current_English: W-wait! Don't do anything rash!

records.Japanese:
なんだあ？
よそ者は引っ込んでな！
records.current_English: Huh? Stay out of this, outsider!

records.Japanese: …下っ端が図に乗るな
records.current_English:
...Don't get cocky,
 you two-bit thug.

records.Japanese:
てめえにゃ関係ねえ！
…この際だ、アズィーザもこいつも
まとめて片付けろ！
records.current_English:
None of your business! 
 While we're at it, let's get rid 
 of Aziza and this guy!

records.Japanese: アル殿、助太刀いたす
records.current_English: Al, I will lend you my blade.

records.Japanese:
あたしもやる！
数を頼むしかない男なんて、最低よ！
records.current_English:
Count me in! Men who have to gang
 up on someone are the worst!

records.Japanese:
ああいう奴らは、景気よくドカーンと
吹き飛ばしましょうか
records.current_English:
Why don't we send them flying
 with a good, loud bang?

records.Japanese:
…海賊ども！
さあ来い、やってやる！
records.current_English: Pirates! Come and face me!

records.Japanese:
どうして…？　なんで、アタシのために
戦ってるんだよ…
さっきまで敵だったのに…
records.current_English:
Why...? Why fight for me?
 We were enemies moments ago...

records.Japanese: く、くそっ、これじゃ分が悪いぜ！
records.current_English: D-damn! We're outmatched!

records.Japanese: ようやく気づいたか
records.current_English: Finally noticed, have you?

records.Japanese: FI・FA…
records.current_English: FI FA...

records.Japanese: …あんたもこの女を助けに来たのか？
records.current_English: You came to save her too?

records.Japanese: そうだと言ったら？
records.current_English: What if I did?

records.Japanese:
ちっ、この女が全部悪いってのに
なんで俺たちがこんな目に…
records.current_English:
Tch. This is all her fault. How'd
 we end up in this mess?

records.Japanese:
…そろそろ、愚痴も言い飽きただろう
もう彼女を解放してはどうだ
records.current_English:
Had enough of complaining? 
 Why don't you let her go?

records.Japanese:
アズィーザがいなくなれば
それでいいのだろう？
records.current_English: You just want Aziza gone, right?

records.Japanese:
聞こえてたのか
もう、誰もこの女にはついていかねえ
records.current_English:
So you heard.
 Nobody follows her now.

records.Japanese:
ならば
アズィーザは俺たちが引き取ろう
records.current_English: Then we'll take Aziza with us.

records.Japanese:
そうかい
だからって、タダでくれてやるわけにゃ
いかねえな
records.current_English:
Fine.
 We ain't letting her go for free.

records.Japanese: 金を取るだと！？
records.current_English: Money?!

records.Japanese:
アル、よせ
で、いくらで手を打つ？
records.current_English: Al, leave it. How much do you want?
One million gold.

records.Japanese: アズィーザ…来い
records.current_English: Aziza... come.

records.Japanese: 用は済んだな。あばよ！
records.current_English: That settles it. So long!

records.Japanese:
まさか、仲間に裏切られるとは
アタシも落ちたもんだよ…
それより、どうしてアタシを
助けたんだ？
records.current_English:
Never thought my own crew
 would turn on me. I've really sunk 
 low... Anyway, why'd you save me?

records.Japanese: 放っておけなかった…
records.current_English: I couldn't leave you there...

records.Japanese:
あの状況で助けないというのは
よほど非人道的な輩だぞ
records.current_English:
Anyone who'd leave you there 
 would have to be heartless.

records.Japanese:
拙者、気になっておったのだが…
そなたほどの者、なぜ海賊などに
身を落としているのだ？
records.current_English:
I've been wondering... Why 
 would someone with your skill
 turn to piracy?

records.Japanese:
買いかぶってくれるね
…身を落としたわけじゃないよ
アタシは海賊の娘。父さんが
海賊なんだ
records.current_English:
You think too highly of me.
 I didn't fall into piracy. 
 I'm a pirate's daughter. 
 My father was one.

records.Japanese: ほう
records.current_English: Oh?

records.Japanese:
さっきの海賊どもは、父さんの手下
子供のころから、見よう見まねで
剣術を覚え
海賊稼業を学んだのさ
records.current_English:
Those pirates
 were my father's crew. I grew up 
 copying them, learning swordplay 
 and the pirate trade.

records.Japanese: 父上はどうされているのだ？
records.current_English: Where is your father?

records.Japanese:
事故で死んだ
…例の剣は父さんの宝物だったのさ
父さんと一緒に消えたけど…
records.current_English:
He died in an accident.
 ...That sword was his treasure.
 It disappeared with him...

records.Japanese:
その剣が
『血塗られたシャムシール』…
records.current_English: The Bloodstained Shamshir...

records.Japanese:
アタシは父さんのような偉大な海賊に
なりたかった
父さんのことはなんでもまねした…
records.current_English:
I wanted to be a great pirate, just
 like him. I copied everything
 he did...

records.Japanese:
だから、あんたたちがこの剣を
持ってるって知ったとき、どうしても
手に入れたくなったんだ
そうすれば…
records.current_English:
When I heard you had his sword,
 I had to get it back. I thought...

records.Japanese:
そうすれば、父さんに近づいた証に
なるって…
ふふっ、だけどね
records.current_English:
I thought it would prove 
 I was a little more like him.
 Heh... But you know what?

records.Japanese:
偉大な海賊になるより、ホントは
父さんの形見が欲しかっただけ
なんだって
気が付いちゃってさ…
records.current_English:
I realized I didn't really want
 to be a great pirate.
 I just wanted something
 to remember my father by...

records.Japanese:
こんなんじゃ、見捨てられて当然ね
金にならない物を追いかけてたんだから
仲間が怒るのも無理ないか
records.current_English:
No wonder they turned on me. 
 I was chasing something
 that wouldn't make them any money. 
 I can't blame them for being angry.

records.Japanese: …まだ海賊に未練があるのか
records.current_English: ...Do you still want to be a pirate?

records.Japanese:
アタシが追っていたのは海賊じゃ
なくて、父さんだったんだもの
もう、足を洗うつもりさ
records.current_English:
I was chasing my father, not a life
 of piracy. I'm done with it.

records.Japanese: 提督…
records.current_English: Sir...

records.Japanese:
アル、言いたいことは分かっている
アズィーザ、俺の船に乗るか？
records.current_English:
I know what you want to say, Al. 
 Aziza, will you sail with us?

records.Japanese:
ありがたいね…
…アタシ、ガンガン働くよ
なんたってアンタは命の恩人だからね
records.current_English:
I'd be grateful. 
 I'll work my heart out.
 I owe you my life, after all.

records.Japanese:
それから、アタシのことは
アズィーザでいいわ
records.current_English: And from now on, just call me Aziza.

records.Japanese:
恩人に忠義を尽くすのも
ひとつの生き方でござる
records.current_English: Serving a savior is a worthy path.

records.Japanese: また賑やかになる…
records.current_English:
Things are going to get
 even livelier...

rows: were my father's crew. I grew up

groups.context: Follow the personal discussion, the joking invitation, and the offer to join the ship after Julio's account.

records.Japanese:
っっっっとおおおおに
しつっこいわね！！！
records.current_English: You just won't give up, will you?!

records.Japanese:
おお！　我が愛しのクリスティナ！
なぜにそんなにまで冷たくするのです？
records.current_English:
Oh, my beloved Cristina! Why 
 must you be so cold to me?

records.Japanese:
あんた、ちょっとおかしいんじゃない？
こんなに嫌われてて、普通ついてくる？
records.current_English:
What's wrong with you? Why 
 keep following someone 
 who can't stand you?

records.Japanese: 照れなくてもよいではないですか～
records.current_English: No need to be shy!

records.Japanese:
はあっ、もういや。…あのねぇ
婚約ったって親が勝手に決めただけ
なの！　私は結婚なんてする気
全然、ないの！
records.current_English:
Ugh, I've had it. Our parents
 arranged the engagement
 without asking me. 
 I'm not getting married. Period!

records.Japanese:
あなたのその声を聞いていられるだけで
私は幸せなぁのでぇす！
records.current_English:
The sound of your voice is all 
 I need to be happy!

records.Japanese: ばかっ！
records.current_English: Moron!

records.Japanese: …あの人…ですか？
records.current_English: ...Is that her?

records.Japanese: そーじゃよ
records.current_English: That's right.

records.Japanese:
ちょっと身辺がゴタゴタしている
ようですが…
records.current_English:
She looks a little busy
 at the moment...

records.Japanese:
いーや。全然かまわんよ
おーい！　クリスティナ！
records.current_English:
Oh, that won't matter. 
 Hey, Cristina!

records.Japanese:
おお、クリスティナ！
元気じゃったか？
records.current_English: Cristina! How have you been?

records.Japanese: じっちゃん！　いつロンドンへ？
records.current_English: Grandpa! When did you get to London?

records.Japanese:
今しがたじゃ
また、船に乗ることになってのぉ
records.current_English: Just now. I'm going to sea again.

records.Japanese:
ええっ、またぁ！？
父さんにも母さんにも止められるよ？
records.current_English:
What, again?! Mom and Dad will try 
 to stop you!

records.Japanese:
おまえが言わなければ
ばれないのじゃ。ふぉっふぉっ
records.current_English:
They won't find out
 if you don't tell them. Ho ho!

records.Japanese: あーのーね～
records.current_English: Oh, come on...

records.Japanese:
それよりどうじゃ
おまえも船出する気はないかの？
records.current_English:
Anyway, how about
 going to sea with me?

records.Japanese:
！！　なーんですと！？
それはいけません！
records.current_English: What?! Absolutely not!

records.Japanese:
何じゃい
こいつは？
records.current_English: Who is this?

records.Japanese:
父さんの友達の息子
えーっと何てったっけ
records.current_English:
The son of one of Dad's friends. 
 What was his name again?

records.Japanese:
おお、クリスティナ！
そんなに照れなくとも！
おじいさまでいらっしゃいますか？
records.current_English:
Oh, Cristina! There's no need
 to be shy! Are you her grandfather?

records.Japanese:
お初にお目にかかります
私はミっヴォール！
ミヴォール・ゲンツと申します
以後お見知りおきをっ
records.current_English:
A pleasure to meet you! Mivor! 
 Mivor Genz, at your service!

records.Japanese:
そうそう、なんか、それそれ
気がついたら
父さんたちが勝手に約束しちゃってて
records.current_English:
Right, that's the name. Before 
 I knew it, Dad and the others
 had made the whole arrangement 
 without me.

records.Japanese:
実は私、この、わけの分かんないのと
婚約したってことになってんの
records.current_English:
Apparently I'm engaged to this...
 whatever he is.

records.Japanese: ほう、そうか
records.current_English: Oh, I see.

records.Japanese: そうか、じゃないわよ！
records.current_English: Don't just say 'oh, I see'!

records.Japanese:
ふむふむ
このなまっちろいのがのう…
records.current_English: Hmm. This pale fellow, is it...

records.Japanese:
わ、私は親に言われたからでは
ありませんが…
本当にクリスティナお嬢様のことを…
records.current_English:
I-it isn't just because our parents
 said so. I really
 do care for Miss Cristina...

records.Japanese:
父さんも母さんもどうやら私に
『いつまでも剣なんか振り回してないで
落ち着け』って言いたいらしいの
よねー。やんなっちゃう
records.current_English:
I think Mom and Dad want me      
 to quit swinging a sword 
 and settle down. 
 It drives me crazy.

records.Japanese:
むう。ヘラルドの考えそうなこと
じゃい。やはり教育を間違えたかのう…
records.current_English:
Hmph. That sounds like Harald. 
 Perhaps I went wrong bringing
 him up...

records.Japanese: あのー
records.current_English: Um...

records.Japanese:
あんたは黙ってなさい！
で、さっきの話なんだけど…
船が何とかって？
records.current_English:
You be quiet! Now, Grandpa, what 
 were you saying about a ship?

records.Japanese:
おお。そうじゃそうじゃ
おまえもわしと一緒に来んかと
思ってのう
records.current_English:
Oh, right! I thought you might like
 to come with me.

records.Japanese:
じいさんによれば
なかなかの剣の使い手だとか
ぶしつけだが、私の船に乗って
もらえまいか？
records.current_English:
Julio says you're
 quite a swordswoman. Pardon
 me for asking out of the blue, 
 but will you come aboard my ship?

records.Japanese:
何？
じっちゃん、この人たち、誰？
records.current_English: What? Grandpa, who are they?

records.Japanese:
うむ。（次から次へと大変じゃ。）
えーっと、まず、こちらは
FI・FA
提督じゃ
records.current_English:
Well... (So much to explain.)
 First, meet Admiral
 FI FA.

records.Japanese: 提督？　へえ、ずいぶん若いのね
records.current_English: An admiral? You're awfully young.

records.Japanese:
おまえも女の身では他流試合がどうとか
言うておったろう。どうじゃ？
世界中に剣術修行に行くというのも
悪くなかろう
records.current_English:
You said it's hard for women 
 to challenge other schools.
 Why not travel the world 
 and train with your sword?

records.Japanese: わ、私は反対ですっ！！！
records.current_English: No! Absolutely not!

records.Japanese:
そうね…。それもいいわね
行くわ
records.current_English:
Hmm... 
 That sounds good to me. I'll go.

records.Japanese: 反対ですってば！！
records.current_English: I said I object!!

records.Japanese: …この男はどうする？
records.current_English: ...What about him?

records.Japanese:
いーのよ。さ、『善は急げ』でしょ？
ね、じっちゃん！
records.current_English:
Never mind him. No time like 
 the present, right, Grandpa?

records.Japanese:
さすが我が孫娘
分かっておる。うむうむ
records.current_English:
That's my granddaughter! You've got
 the right idea.

records.Japanese: ミヴォールとやら、ついてくるか？
records.current_English:
Mivor, was it? Would you like
 to come too?

records.Japanese: わ、わたくしは…
records.current_English: W-well...

records.Japanese:
この人、泳げないの。水恐怖症なのよ
だから追ってなんかこれないわよねー
records.current_English:
He can't swim. 
 He's terrified of water. 
 You can't follow us, can you?

records.Japanese:
くっ…。かくなる上はっ！
け、剣で勝負だっ！
records.current_English:
Then there's only one thing for it!
 I-I challenge you to a duel!

records.Japanese:
本当にもう、分かんない人ねっ！
たぁーっ！！
records.current_English: You just never learn, do you?! Hyaa!

records.Japanese: うわーーーっ！！　あたたたた！
records.current_English: Waaah! Ouch!

records.Japanese:
そんなへっぴり腰じゃ
子供にだって勝てやしないわよ
records.current_English:
With a stance like that, you 
 couldn't beat a child.

records.Japanese:
うむ
腕は鈍っておらんようじゃ
records.current_English: Good. Your skills haven't dulled.

records.Japanese:
ひいい、父上に買っていただいた
レイピアがあ～！
records.current_English:
Eeeek! My rapier! Father bought
 that for me!

records.Japanese:
さっ、行きましょう！
剣術試合もいいけど
船旅だって楽しみよね！
records.current_English:
Come on, let's go! 
 I'm looking forward
 to the sword matches,
 but the voyage sounds fun too!

rows: if you don't tell them. Ho ho!
me for asking out of the blue,
but will you come aboard my ship?

groups.context: Review the whole conversation around the invitation to keep talking despite disbelief.

records.Japanese:
FI！
あの船の旗！
records.current_English: FI! Look at that ship's flag!

records.Japanese:
あの『グラスにドクロ』の旗…
あれはイギリス王室の海賊…
クリフォードの船…
records.current_English:
That flag with a skull in a
 goblet... That's Clifford's ship.
 He's the English Crown's pirate...

records.Japanese: 間違いねえ、『ギャラハット号』だ！
records.current_English: No mistake--the Galahad!

records.Japanese: 『ギャラハット』？　うまいの？
records.current_English: Galahad? Does it taste good?

records.Japanese: バカ！　食いもんじゃねえ！
records.current_English: You idiot! It's not food!

records.Japanese:
提督、早くこの街を出ましょう！
関わると、ろくなことがありやせんぜ！
records.current_English:
Admiral, let's get out of this 
 town! Nothing good will come 
 of getting mixed up with him!

records.Japanese:
やばいよ、FI！
早くこの街を出なきゃ
ヤツは、相当な悪人だっていうし…
records.current_English:
This is bad, FI!
 We need to get out of town.
 They say he's vicious...

records.Japanese:
クリフォードってのは、そんなに
ひどいヤツなのかい？
records.current_English:
Is this Clifford fellow really 
 that bad?

records.Japanese:
あんた、この街は初めてなのね？
ジェームズ・クリフォードってのは
泣く子も黙る鬼海賊って噂よ
records.current_English:
Your first time here, right? 
 They say James Clifford's a pirate 
 so fearsome even crying children 
 go quiet at his name.

records.Japanese:
何でも、雲を突くような巨漢で
目が３つあって、口は耳まで裂けてて
人の生き血をグラスに注いで
飲むらしいわ
records.current_English:
They say he's a towering giant 
 with three eyes and a mouth that 
 stretches from ear to ear. He
 drinks human blood from a goblet!

records.Japanese: おいおい、それは人間かい？
records.current_English: Come on, is that even a human being?

records.Japanese:
だってだって、たった１人で１つの
艦隊を全滅させちゃうのよ
絶対、化物よ！
records.current_English:
But he wiped out an entire fleet 
 all by himself! He has to be 
 a monster!

records.Japanese:
俺が化物か…
ははは、こいつは参ったな
records.current_English:
Me, a monster...? Ha ha ha! Well,
 that's a new one.

records.Japanese:
でしょ？　ホント参っちゃうわ
…？
records.current_English: Exactly! What a nightmare. ...Wait.

records.Japanese:
俺って…。まさか、あんたが？
ク、クリフォード？？
records.current_English:
Me...? Wait, are you...? 
 C-Clifford?!

records.Japanese: なにー！　この優男がクリフォード！？
records.current_English: What?! This pretty boy is Clifford?!

records.Japanese: なんと、この男がクリフォードだと！
records.current_English: What? This man is Clifford?!

records.Japanese:
まあ、そんなとこかな…
化物はひどいねえ…
records.current_English:
More or less... Though calling me
 a monster seems a little harsh.

records.Japanese:
ま、まずいよ
FI…
早く謝りなよ
records.current_English:
Th-this is bad, FI... Apologize 
 to him, quick!

records.Japanese:
ご、ごめんなさい…
まさかあのクリフォードが
こんな普通の人だなんて……あっ！
records.current_English:
I-I'm sorry... I never thought 
 the famous Clifford would look so
 ordinary... Oh!

records.Japanese: FIっ！
records.current_English: FI!

records.Japanese:
いいよ、いいよ。気にしちゃいない
それより君
FI・FAだね？
records.current_English:
No harm done. Now, you're
 FI FA?

records.Japanese: 知ってるの、あたしたちのこと？
records.current_English: You know about us?

records.Japanese:
まあな。この仕事やってると
いろんな情報が入ってくる
records.current_English:
Well, yes. You hear all sorts
 of things in my line of work.

records.Japanese:
まさか、FOに
手を出す気…？
records.current_English:
You're not planning to go after
 FO, are you...?

records.Japanese:
おいおい、俺が何でもかんでも
潰すというのは単なる噂だよ
records.current_English:
Come now. The idea that I crush
 anything and everything is 
 just a rumor.

records.Japanese: そうかしら……？
records.current_English: Really...?

records.Japanese:
まあ、信じるも信じないも
君の勝手だ
ともかく、君と話をしたい
records.current_English:
Believe me or not, 
 that's up to you. Either way,
 I'd like to talk to you.

records.Japanese: 話って？
records.current_English: Talk about what?

records.Japanese:
…ここじゃ、ちょっとな
今夜、俺の家に来てほしい
夕食を共にしながら話したい
records.current_English:
I'd rather not discuss it here...
 Come to my home tonight. I'd like
 us to talk over dinner.

records.Japanese: んん？　いま、ごはんって言った！？
records.current_English: Huh? Did you say dinner?!

records.Japanese:
ああ
客人としておもてなししよう
records.current_English:
Yes. I'll see that you're well 
 looked after as my guests.

records.Japanese: うん。分かった
records.current_English: All right.

records.Japanese: では、今夜。待ってるぞ
records.current_English:
Tonight, then. I'll be 
 expecting you.

records.Japanese:
…カミル、聞いた？　ディナーよ！
王国直属の海賊なら、きっと大邸宅
よねっ！
う～ん、わくわくしちゃう！
records.current_English:
Camille, did you hear? Dinner! 
 A pirate who works for the Crown 
 must have a huge mansion! Ooh, 
 I can't wait!

records.Japanese:
おいらも、わくわくだよ！
早く行きたいな～
records.current_English:
I can't wait either! Let's hurry 
 up and go!

records.Japanese:
ちょっと…。もしかして
その格好で出かけるつもり？
records.current_English:
Wait... Are you going dressed
 like that?

records.Japanese: えっ？　これじゃ変…？
records.current_English: Huh? Do I look that odd?

records.Japanese:
…あのねえ
あの人は海賊とはいえ、英国直属なの
つまり、貴族なんだよ
records.current_English:
Listen... He may be a pirate,
 but he serves the English Crown. 
 In other words, he's a nobleman.

records.Japanese: うん。そうなんじゃない？
records.current_English: Well, yes. I suppose so.

records.Japanese:
貴族のお宅に伺うんだから
海に出るのと同じ格好はないと
思うんだけど
records.current_English:
We're visiting a nobleman's home.
 I don't think you should wear
 the same clothes you wear at sea.

records.Japanese:
そっか…。そりゃそうよねえ
どうしよう？
records.current_English:
Oh... You're right. What 
 should we do?

records.Japanese:
うーん…。とにかく、ドレスを
手配しなきゃ。急いで作ってくれるよう
仕立屋に頼んでみよう
records.current_English:
Hmm... First, we need to find
 you a dress. Let's ask a tailor
 to make one in a hurry.

records.Japanese: うん！
records.current_English: Okay!

records.Japanese: なんとか夜までに間に合ったね
records.current_English:
We managed to get it ready in time 
 for tonight.

records.Japanese: おいら、待ちくたびれたよお
records.current_English: Waiting took forever!

records.Japanese:
それにしても…
驚いたよ…
records.current_English: Still... I didn't expect this...

records.Japanese: へへ、どう？
records.current_English: Heh. Well?

records.Japanese: 『馬子にも衣装』ってやつだね
records.current_English: Amazing what a nice dress can do.

records.Japanese:
…
（バカ。カミル、言葉を選べ！）
records.current_English:
... (Idiot! Choose your words, 
 Camille!)

records.Japanese:
…カミルに聞いたあたしが
バカだったわ…
records.current_English: I was a fool to ask Camille...

records.Japanese: おお、来たか
records.current_English: Ah, you're here.

records.Japanese:
FI・FA
です。晩餐へのご招待
ありがとうございます
records.current_English:
I'm FI FA. Thank you 
 for inviting us to dinner.

records.Japanese:
ほう…、どこかのご令嬢かと思ったよ
似合うじゃないか
records.current_English:
My... I almost took you for a young
 lady from a fine family. That
 dress suits you.

records.Japanese:
うふふ。クリフォードさん
口がうまいんだから
records.current_English:
Hee hee. You're quite the charmer, 
 Clifford.

records.Japanese:
どっかの誰かさんも
見習ってほしいくらいだわ
records.current_English:
I wish a certain someone would take
 a lesson from you.

records.Japanese: さあ、入ってくれ
records.current_English: Come inside.

records.Japanese:
すごいご馳走！
数え切れないくらいのお料理…
records.current_English:
What a feast! There are more dishes
 than I can count...

records.Japanese: す、すげえ…
records.current_English: A-amazing...

records.Japanese:
見たことないものばかりだよ！　ホント
どれから食べていいのか
迷っちゃうな…
もぐもぐ……す、すごくおいしい！
records.current_English:
I've never seen any of this
 food before! I don't know what 
 to try first... Munch, munch...
 It's so good!

records.Japanese:
おいしいなあ！
どれもこれもおいしいよ！
records.current_English: Delicious! Every dish is wonderful!

records.Japanese:
エミリオ、ブタじゃねえんだから
ナイフとフォークぐらい使え！
records.current_English:
Emilio, you're not a pig! At least 
 use a knife and fork!

records.Japanese: ふむ、なかなか結構な味だ
records.current_English: Hm. Quite good.

records.Japanese:
ははは、喜んでくれてうれしいよ
遠慮なく食べてくれ
records.current_English:
Ha ha ha! I'm glad you're enjoying 
 it. Help yourselves.

records.Japanese: さて、話というのは…
records.current_English:
Now, about what I wanted 
 to discuss...

records.Japanese:
ちょっと待って
このドレス窮屈で…
records.current_English: Wait. This dress is too tight...

records.Japanese:
ああ、もう
FIったら…
records.current_English: Oh, honestly, FI...

records.Japanese:
ははは。ムリしないでいいよ
じゃあ、奧で着替えておいで
records.current_English:
Ha ha ha! There's no need
 to force yourself. Go and change 
 in the back.

records.Japanese:
ふう。やっぱりドレスより、こっちの
ほうが、あたしには合ってるなあ
…ごめんなさい、お待たせしちゃって
records.current_English:
Whew. These clothes suit me much 
 better than that dress. Sorry
 to keep you waiting.

records.Japanese: さてと。じゃあ本題に入ろうか
records.current_English: Now, down to business.

records.Japanese:
スペイン王国の海軍総司令に
ペドロ・バルデスという男が就任した
のは知っているか？　こいつがまた
歴代総司令でも一二を争う強者だ
records.current_English:
Did you hear? Pedro Valdes is now
 commander in chief of Spain's
 navy. He's one of the strongest
 commanders they've ever had.

records.Japanese: その話なら、私も聞いたことがある
records.current_English: That news reached me too.

records.Japanese:
スペインか…。あの無敵艦隊が
いま以上に強くなられちゃ
たまらないわよ
records.current_English:
Spain... The last thing we need
 is for that Armada to get even 
 stronger.

records.Japanese: そうだろう？　それは俺にも同じだ
records.current_English: Exactly. And the same goes for me.

records.Japanese:
えー？　ウソでしょ？
クリフォード軍は無敵で
スペイン海軍なんて眼中にないって
評判よ？
records.current_English:
What? You're kidding! They say your
 fleet's invincible and doesn't 
 even consider the Spanish navy 
 a threat!

records.Japanese:
いくらなんでも
あの男が相手となると…
records.current_English: Even so, with that man in command...

records.Japanese: そんなにすごい相手なんだ…
records.current_English: He's that formidable...?

records.Japanese:
そこで、君に相談だ
俺と手を組まないか？
records.current_English:
So here's my proposal. 
 Why don't you join forces with me?

records.Japanese: あたしたちと？　どういうこと？
records.current_English: With us? What do you mean?

records.Japanese:
俺たちが協力しあえば、奴らとて
そう簡単には手を出せまい
そうだろう？
records.current_English:
If we work together, even they 
 won't be so quick to move against
 us. Don't you agree?

records.Japanese: ふむ、悪い手ではないが…
records.current_English: Hmm. Not a bad idea, but...

records.Japanese:
…そうかもしれない
でも、スペイン海軍を倒すなんて
あたし…
records.current_English:
Maybe you're right. But taking 
 on the Spanish navy... I don't 
 think I...

records.Japanese:
おいおい。君たちにそんなことは
求めていないよ
records.current_English:
Come now. I'm not asking you 
 to do that.

records.Japanese: じゃあ、何よ？
records.current_English: Then what?

records.Japanese:
いいかい。君は俺と手を組んで
奴らの動きを牽制する
records.current_English:
Listen. You join forces with me, 
 and we keep their movements
 in check.

records.Japanese: それだけ？
records.current_English: That's all?

records.Japanese:
それで十分だ。なあ、世界は広いんだぜ
共同でヤツの勢力を押さえておいて
それぞれ、他の地域に勢力を
伸ばすんだよ
records.current_English:
That's enough. Look, it's a big
 world. Together, we keep his 
 forces in check while each of us 
 expands into other regions.

records.Japanese:
そっか！　北海じゃなくて、お互いが
アフリカやインドに向かうのね！
records.current_English:
Oh, I see! Instead of staying
 in the North Sea, we each head 
 for places like Africa and India!

records.Japanese: なるほどな…
records.current_English: Makes sense.

records.Japanese: そうだ
records.current_English: Right.

records.Japanese:
俺はイギリス本国の方針通りに
新大陸に向かい、君はオランダの
南下政策に従って、アフリカから
インド、アジアへと向かう
records.current_English:
I'll follow English policy 
 to the New World. You'll follow
 Dutch policy south, through Africa 
 to India and Asia.

records.Japanese: そうして力を蓄えれば…
records.current_English:
And once we've built up our
 strength...

records.Japanese:
…いつかは、あの無敵艦隊を倒せる日が
来るってことね！
records.current_English:
Someday we can defeat that 
 mighty Armada!

records.Japanese: そうだ。物分かりがいいな
records.current_English: Right. You learn fast.

records.Japanese: でも…
records.current_English: But...

records.Japanese: ん？　何か問題があるのか？
records.current_English: Hm? Is there a problem?

records.Japanese: あんたを信じていいのかどうか…
records.current_English: I don't know if I can trust you...

records.Japanese:
おやおや
これでも英国紳士だぜ
records.current_English:
Come now. I am an English
 gentleman, after all.

records.Japanese: そんなの関係ないわ
records.current_English: That doesn't prove a thing.

records.Japanese: 口では何とでも言えるからな…
records.current_English: Words alone prove nothing...

records.Japanese:
じゃあ、友好のしるしに
『紅色の顔料』をやってもいい
records.current_English:
Then how about the Red Dye 
 as a token of friendship?

records.Japanese: 顔料…？　何それ？
records.current_English: Dye...? What's that?

records.Japanese:
お宝が眠っている場所の地図を
解き明かす鍵なんだそうだ
…で、どうだ？　俺と組むか？
records.current_English:
They say it's the key
 to deciphering a map to hidden 
 treasure. So? Will you join
 forces with me?

records.Japanese: とりあえず、信じるしかないようだな…
records.current_English:
For now, it looks like we'll have
 to trust him...

records.Japanese: …ええ
records.current_English: ...All right.

records.Japanese:
そうこなくっちゃな！
よろしく頼むぜ！
records.current_English:
That's the spirit! Let's make
 this work!

records.Japanese:
新大陸には、あまり手を出さないで
ほしい。あそこに居座る連中は
俺の獲物なんだ
勝手にやり合ったりしないでくれよ
records.current_English:
I'd rather you didn't meddle 
 in the New World.
 The lot holed up there are my prey.
 Don't fight them on your own.

records.Japanese:
『紅色の顔料』は酒場の親父が
持っている
アムステルダムの酒場に行ってくれ
records.current_English:
The barkeep at the Amsterdam tavern
 has the Red Dye. Go see him.

records.Japanese:
分かったわ。言っとくけど
あたしを裏切ったら許さないからね！
records.current_English:
All right. But let me be clear:
 if you betray me, I'll never 
 forgive you!

rows: that's up to you. Either way,
I'd like to talk to you.

groups.context: Follow Rafael's identification and the other characters' responses.

records.Japanese:
この街って、北海と地中海をつなぐ
重要な拠点なんだね
records.current_English:
A vital link between the North Sea 
 and the Med.

records.Japanese:
でも、ポルトガルの軍や商会が
がっちり握ってて全然商売させて
くれないのよねー
records.current_English:
But Portugal's military
 and trading companies
 have it locked down. 
 They won't let us trade!

records.Japanese: あのー
records.current_English: Um...

records.Japanese: なあに？
records.current_English: What?

records.Japanese:
FOの
FIさん
だよね？
records.current_English: You're FO's FI, right?

records.Japanese:
へー、あたしも有名になったもんね
で、あんた誰？
records.current_English:
Oh, I must be getting famous!
 So, who are you?

records.Japanese:
僕は、カストール商会の
ラファエル・カストール
records.current_English:
I'm Rafael Castor, 
 with the Castor Company.

records.Japanese:
えーっ！！
あんたが、カストール商会の！？
records.current_English: What?! The Castor Company?!

records.Japanese: 信じらんない、まだ子供じゃないの！
records.current_English:
I don't believe it!
 You're just a kid!

records.Japanese: FI！！
records.current_English: FI!!

records.Japanese: 子供…
records.current_English: Kid...

records.Japanese:
お、おまえに言われたかねえよ！
なあ、ラフィ！
records.current_English:
Y-you're one to talk!
 Right, Rafael?!

records.Japanese:
なんですってえ！？
なに、この失礼な筋肉男？
ちょっと、あたしにケンカ売ってんの？
records.current_English:
What?! Who's this rude muscleman?
 Looking for a fight?

records.Japanese:
こらこらァ！
そっちが先に言ったんだろうが！
records.current_English: Hey, you started it!

records.Japanese: FI、この人の言うとおりだよ！
records.current_English: FI, he has a point!

records.Japanese: まあまあ、クラウも落ち着いて
records.current_English: Easy, Claudio.

records.Japanese: おまえも、ちっとは怒れって！
records.current_English: You should be mad too!

records.Japanese:
いいよ
僕は気にしてないから
records.current_English: No harm done. Really.

records.Japanese: おまえなあ～
records.current_English: You...

records.Japanese: ねえ。この人、ホントに提督さんなの？
records.current_English: He's really an admiral?

records.Japanese: そうだけど…？
records.current_English: Yes...

records.Japanese: なんか、拍子ぬけだなあ…
records.current_English: That's... underwhelming.

records.Japanese:
…こほん
で、あたしになんか用？
records.current_English: Ahem. Did you need me?

records.Japanese: この街で契約したいんでしょ？
records.current_English:
You want to get a contract 
 here, right?

records.Japanese:
ず、ずいぶんトートツね、あんた
確かにそうだけど…
records.current_English: That came out of nowhere! But yes...

records.Japanese:
じゃあさ。もしよかったら
君が持ってるナントのシェアと
僕の持ってるリスボンのシェアを
交換してくれない？
records.current_English:
Then, if you're willing, 
 would you trade your market share
 in Nantes for mine in Lisbon?

records.Japanese: えっ、交換！？
records.current_English: A trade?!

records.Japanese: もし、よかったら…なんだけど
records.current_English: Only if you want to.

records.Japanese:
うーん、悪い話じゃないけど…
１％ずつの交換でいいの？
records.current_English:
Hmm... Not a bad deal. 
 Is one percent each okay?

records.Japanese:
おっと、そうはいかねえ
リスボンは大都市だし、交通のカナメ
だからな。２対１がいいとこだろ？
records.current_English:
Hold on. Lisbon's a big city 
 and a major hub. Two to one
 is the best you'll get.

records.Japanese:
こっちがナントの２％を明け渡したら
そっちがリスボンの１％をくれるって
わけ？
records.current_English:
So we give you 2 percent of Nantes 
 for 1 percent of Lisbon?

records.Japanese: うん
records.current_English: Yes.

records.Japanese:
イヤなら別にいいんだぜ
他をあたるからよ
records.current_English:
If you don't want the deal, fine.
 We'll ask someone else.

records.Japanese: どうかな？
records.current_English: What do you think?

records.Japanese: うーん…、いいわよ
records.current_English: Hmm... fine, then.

records.Japanese: バッカじゃないの？
records.current_English: Are you nuts?

records.Japanese:
あんたのおぼっちゃま顔見てたら
どーでもよくなってきたわ…
records.current_English:
That pampered face... Oh, who cares
 about the terms?

records.Japanese:
ま、地中海に出るのにリスボンを
通らないわけにはいかないしね
records.current_English:
Besides, we have to pass Lisbon
 to reach the Mediterranean.

records.Japanese: 商談成立だね！
records.current_English: Deal!

records.Japanese:
よし、これで北海進出の足がかりが
できたぜ！
records.current_English: Great! A foothold in the North Sea!

records.Japanese:
ありがとう、FIさん！
これからもよろしく！
records.current_English:
Thank you, FI!
 I look forward to working with you!

records.Japanese:
ナントとリスボンのシェアを
交換しました
records.current_English:
Market shares in Nantes and Lisbon 
 have been exchanged.

records.Japanese:
ふんっ
そんな口車には乗らないんだから
records.current_English:
Hmph! I'm not falling
 for that smooth talk!

records.Japanese:
うーん、ダメかあ
いい条件だと思ったんだけど…
records.current_English: Oh... Too bad. Seemed fair to me.

records.Japanese: しょうがねえな。他をあたるか
records.current_English: Oh well. Let's ask someone else.

records.Japanese:
もういいよ、クラウ。人をあてにする
なんて、やっぱり虫がよすぎたんだ
自分たちでコツコツやっていくのが
一番だよ
records.current_English:
It's all right, Claudio. 
 We were asking too much, counting
 on others. We're better off
 working steadily on our own.

records.Japanese:
ちっ
どうも地味にかせぐってのは
俺の性分に合わねえんだよなあ
records.current_English:
Tch. That slow, steady 
 way of making money
 just isn't my style.

records.Japanese: 変な人たち…
records.current_English: Odd pair...
